author: Suvom
quote: Sold $79.99 worth of pure hype for a 99 Metascore, only for reality to crash straight to 5.4. After making us wait over a decade for Vice City with Jason and Lucia, the final result feels like a masterclass in overhyped marketing. Critics clearly handed out tens with their eyes closed, while players finally brought the score back to reality. The worst game ever!

author: Suvom
quote: In an era dominated by bloated open worlds, aggressive monetization, and hollow hype, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time stands as a reminder of what true game craftsmanship looks like. Rebuilt from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2, this remake doesn't just slap a modern coat of paint onto a classic it respects every ounce of the original's atmosphere, pacing, and timeless design. The overhauled visuals and voiced cutscenes bring Hyrule to life with a grounded, magical warmth that never feels stiff or overly artificial. Every dungeon, every melody on the Ocarina, and every quiet moment riding across Hyrule Field carries genuine weight and emotion. The combat feels tight and responsive, the world design still outclasses almost every modern action adventure game, and the iconic soundtrack hits harder than ever. This isn't nostalgia talking it's pure, uncompromising game design at its peak. Easily the undisputed Game of the Year. 10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
